# Highest-risk claims

What the guide says stellar-core does NOT validate. These are the hardest statements to establish from code: a check can sit in a file or a stage the source links do not cover, and no ledger can show that a check is absent everywhere. Both lists are derived from `guide/claims.yaml` and `corpus/fields.yaml`, so they follow every change; claims on a code reference alone come first in each.
